steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The geological timescale divides Earth's 4.6 billion year history into eons, eras, periods and epochs | Key Fact: Principle of superposition: in undisturbed sequences, the oldest rocks are at the bottom and youngest at the top | Key Fact: Principle of original horizontality: sedimentary rocks are deposited horizontally; tilting indicates later deformation | Key Fact: Principle of cross-cutting relationships: a feature that cuts another is younger than what it cuts

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from geological time &amp; stratigraphy, and one past-paper question.
